title: Rental losses and an ISO sale — Rae Lin
instructions: Rae Lin is single. Compute the effect of her rental activities and her 2025 stock option transactions.

exhibits.title: Rental and passive activities
exhibits.content:
- MAGI before any passive items: **$130,000**
- Rental house (Rae actively participates; 100% owner): 2025 net loss **$(30,000)**
- Limited partnership interest (no participation): 2025 net income **$6,000**
- No prior-year suspended losses

exhibits.title: Incentive stock options
exhibits.content:
- Granted **March 1, 2023**: 1,000 shares at a **$10** strike
- Exercised **February 3, 2025** when FMV was **$30**
- Sold all 1,000 shares **November 14, 2025** for **$45** per share

rows.label: Net passive loss after combining the rental and the LP
Special allowance for rental real estate
Ordinary income from the ISO shares
rows.explanation: Disqualifying disposition (sold within 1 year of exercise): lesser of (30 − 10) or (45 − 10), × 1,000 = **20,000**.

rows.label: 2025 AMT adjustment for the exercise
rows.explanation: The shares were sold in the same year as exercise, so no AMT adjustment remains: **0**.

rows.label: The $15,000 capital gain
rows.explanation: Held less than 1 year after exercise.

rows.label: Employer's deduction for the ISO
rows.explanation: The employer deducts the ordinary income from a disqualifying disposition.
